inference_substrate_details.operation: original human annotation and source exposure audit

preconditions_checked.dependencies: stdlib and imported existing reporting helpers
preconditions_checked.network_policy: Retained bounded public curl requests only; local CLI authenticates their pinned bytes.

annotation_origin_rows.author_policy_phrase: manual annotations at both the individual cases and word levels

criterion_policy.ambiguity: Human source support is fallible. implicit_true can be factually true but absent from context. No individual annotator IDs or independent adjudication records.
criterion_policy.overlap: NFKC/casefold/whitespace; exact documents or shared contiguous32-word window; transitive union
criterion_policy.primary: any original human unsupported span, including implicit_true
criterion_policy.sensitivity: retain original categories, implicit_true, due_to_null, comments and quality; exclude implicit_true only in sensitivity
